items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: But my grandfather, Jack Ramey, was a whiz on violin.

ctx.x: So really there was quite a strong sort of musical side on the Glasgow side?

On the Glasgow side, and also on the Ramey side, too, except that, you know how it is when your father dies, your mother doesn't tell you too much about those over on your father's side. We got the remnants of it later on. But my grandfather, Jack Ramey, was a whiz on violin. And they said -- funny thing, they said that I took some of it after him, although I never saw him. They said when he played, sometimes he'd have his foot as much as a foot off the ground, patting his foot, you know. And you know, I play…
My mother told me, she said, you know, you got that from your grandfather.
